messages.author: 5023feaabf0d4aa7
messages.subject: Difficulty with simple univariate boxplot
parts:
Dear all, From the Deducer menu I'm attempting to produce univariate boxplots for 3 continuous variables using Plot -> Interactive -> Box-plot (wide). Two of these variables result in the expected plots [as confirmed by the base command boxplot()]
The above menu sequence equates to a call to ibox as follows:
ibox(births[,c("gestwks")]).
The result is very odd - I see the outer leaves of the boxplot (connected by a straight line) but no central box and no evidence of any outliers. A summary of the variable shows that there are 10 missing values.
summary(births$gestwks)
Min. 1st Qu. Median Mean 3rd Qu. Max. NA's
24.69 37.94 39.12 38.72 40.09 43.16 10.00

Neither of the other variables have missing values - is that the issue? Although the Plot -> Interactive -> Histogram plots OK and confirms that the distribution is highly negatively skewed.
Any ideas as to what the problem is and how to get around it?
